run_preprocess_ef_cli: run the preprocess_ef script to create LMDB files from extxyz trajectory files for the S2EF task
run_write_images_to_lmdb: run write_images_to_lmdb to convert ASE trajectory frames into pickled graph data objects stored in an LMDB database
run_main: run main to extract graph features from extxyz files using AtomsToGraphs and write them to chunked LMDB files
run_get_parser: run get_parser to build an argparse parser with data-path, out-path, num-workers, ref-energy, and test-data flags
refactor_write_images_to_lmdb: refactor write_images_to_lmdb to change how trajectory frames are parsed, tagged, or written to the LMDB store
